audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer described this as an even ball-placement mirror you win, while the content layer and the packet both call it a losing lane (45.76% over 3990 games, Syndra on five of seven rows).
audit.why: Range decides it: Command: Attack is 815, Dark Sphere is 800, but Force of Will reaches 925, so she chips from outside your ball once W is up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave and the phases whys now say level 1 is yours on the 815-vs-800 gap and the lane turns from level 2.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' and 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar' — the second is a magnitude with no source, and level 6 is even at best.
audit.why: Unleashed Power is 120/100/80s and executes; Command: Shockwave is 110/95/80s and needs setup. Her first item plus Splinters bursts through a 9s shield.
audit.corrected: Spike line rewritten to mana at Lost Chapter, an even level 6, and her first item out-bursting your shield.
sources: brief enemyKit R cd 120/100/80 with execute flag
brief ownerKit R cd 110/95/80, E cd 9

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text claimed 'her Q costs less than your Command: Attack'. Dark Sphere costs 40/45/50/55/60; Command: Attack costs a flat 35. The claim is backwards. spikes[3].text claimed her R 'chunks you from screen's edge' — Unleashed Power is 675 range, shorter than your 815 Q. breakdown.cooldowns contained no cooldown number at all.
audit.why: Both errors change how a player positions: she is not cheaper, and her ult forces her to step inside your range.
audit.corrected: Costs claim removed; R restated as 675 range she must step in to use; cooldowns field now carries Scatter the Weak 15s flat, Dark Sphere 7s, Unleashed Power 120s at rank 1.
sources: brief enemyKit Q cost 40/45/50/55/60, R range 675, E cd 15

audit.why: 45.76% over 3990 games is already the figure the page reflects in its Syndra-favoured chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization named Zed ('buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6') in a Syndra matchup, and never addressed that stacking MR is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Transcendent grants Force of Will bonus true damage — resistances do not reduce it. This is the flagged missing interaction for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Zed clause replaced with Zhonya's against her R plus a note that her W deals true damage.

notes: Biggest defect here: all seven phases[N].side values contradicted content win[N] — the page rendered two answers for every level row. win[] matched the packet levelChart and the whys, so the sides were moved to win[] and all seven phases whys were rewritten in the same atomic group. phases[N].rating left untouched (polarity of the rating scale is not documented in the brief). Factual corrections: Dark Sphere costs 40/45/50/55/60 versus Command: Attack's flat 35, so the shipped claim that her Q is cheaper was backwards; and Unleashed Power is 675 range, shorter than your 815 Q, so 'chunks you from screen's edge' was wrong. Pronouns: Syndra is female and the full layer called her he/his in a dozen fields — all fixed. Left templated but not grounded: report[12].t (play-from-behind) and breakdown.difficulty, which are Orianna-generic but contain nothing false.
